description: Agent skills published by Learndiag, a free Praxis 5001 (Elementary Education: Multiple Subjects) readiness tool for teacher candidates.

skills.name: practice-praxis-questions
skills.title: Fetch original Praxis 5001 practice questions
skills.description: Pull practice questions from the free 969-question bank, filtered by subtest (5002 reading, 5003 math, 5004 social studies, 5005 science), category or keyword.

skills.name: quiz-me
skills.title: Run a timed Praxis 5001 mini quiz
skills.description: Draw a small random set of Praxis 5001 questions, present them one at a time, score the answers and explain what was missed.

skills.name: find-study-guide
skills.title: Find the right Praxis 5001 study guide
skills.description: Point the user at the relevant Learndiag study-guide article — subtest guides, the four-gate strategy, retake planning, and 5001-vs-other-exam comparisons — available in HTML or markdown.
